Poss-SLPC sro Appoints New Managing Director Amid Strategic Growth Plans

Poss-SLPC sro, a leading player in Slovakia’s steel industry, has announced the appointment of Peter Hric as its new Managing Director, effective immediately. The move comes as the company seeks to strengthen its position in the Central European steel market and expand its value-added production capabilities.

Hric brings over 25 years of experience in the steel sector, having previously held senior roles at several regional manufacturers. He succeeds Lucia Vargova, who is stepping down after more than a decade at the helm. Vargova will remain with Poss-SLPC sro in an advisory capacity during the transition period.

In a statement, Poss-SLPC sro’s Board of Directors welcomed Hric, citing his “strong track record in operational excellence and innovative leadership.” The Board emphasized the company’s commitment to investing in advanced manufacturing technologies and sustainability initiatives. “Peter’s appointment marks an exciting new chapter for Poss-SLPC sro,” said Board Chair Juraj Novak. “His expertise will help us drive efficiency, respond to evolving customer needs, and reinforce our dedication to responsible production.”

Hric said he was “honoured to join Poss-SLPC sro at this pivotal time.” He outlined his immediate priorities, which include deepening relationships with automotive and construction sector clients, optimizing supply chain operations, and pursuing new partnerships in neighbouring markets. “Poss-SLPC sro has a proud legacy in Slovakia’s industrial landscape,” Hric commented. “We are well-positioned to embrace the challenges and opportunities ahead, with a focus on quality, reliability, and environmental stewardship.”

Slovakia’s steel industry has experienced stable demand in recent years, buoyed by infrastructure investments and steady export flows within the EU. According to data from the Slovak Steel Federation, domestic steel production reached 4.1 million tonnes last year, up 2% from 2022. Trade analysts say Poss-SLPC sro’s leadership transition comes at a time of cautious optimism for the sector.

“Continuity in management and a clear vision for modernization are key for Slovak steelmakers,” said Martina Benova, an industry analyst at Market Insights Central Europe. “Poss-SLPC sro’s latest appointment signals a strategic approach to sustainable growth.”
